purpose: Point out that something only happens or has only one aspect, often with an unsatisfactory result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Noun + ばかりで; verb plain form + ばかりで
This shop had only expensive items, so I could not buy anything.
My brother only complains and does not help.
The explanation is full of technical terms, so I cannot understand it.
formation: Noun + ばかりで; verb plain form + ばかりで
restrictions: Frequently followed by a negative consequence or missing alternative.
mistake: With ongoing repeated behavior, use てばかりいる.
